verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Reclaim automates out-of-office visibility (reclaim-docs-10) and lets users tune recurring routines/availability throttling via Habits (reclaim-docs-4, reclaim-comm-1), which supports part of the availability-schedule story, but there is no explicit documentation of setting standard working-hours blocks or one-off date overrides for availability. Missing for 10: explicit working-hours configuration UI, date-specific override mechanics, and independent confirmation these granular controls work as described.
